steps.name: a morph interrupted by a new form keeps the camera and lens continuous
steps.js: (async () => { const st = window.__stage, frames = n => new Promise(r => { const f = () => (n-- > 0 ? requestAnimationFrame(f) : r()); f(); }); st.setForm(2); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1300)); await frames(1); const a = { ...st.cam }; st.setForm(3); await frames(2); const b = st.cam; return [Math.abs(b.pitch - a.pitch) < 0.05, Math.abs(b.dist - a.dist) < 0.05, Math.abs(b.lens - a.lens) < 0.05]; })()
